main_text.head: N LVDOVICI MASVRII Poema de Babylonis ruina.
main_text.p: Vm Masuri, grande ore tonas Babylona ruentem, Cantata est quanta Troia nec ipsa tuba: Est quod Maonides, est quod tibi maior & ipso Maonida, invideat forsitan ipse Maro. Error in hoc tamen est, Masuri, quod carmine tanto Manfuram aeternum quam ruis adificas.
main_text.head: n Horrendum parricidium aduersus HENRICVM IIII. Galliæ & Nauarræ Regem, attentatum à IOANNE CASTELLO, Parisiensi, Iesuitarum discipulo, & iidem conscius hoc parricidium aggresso.
main_text.p: HEnrici iugulum Regis, quo Gallia rege Perstat adhuc, peteret quum scelerata manus: Auersans scelus hoc tantum, qui celsus ab alto Fata hominum iusta cum ratione regit. Henrici a iugulo, gladium convertit in ora: Captro impar, sed enim sic quoque grande nefas.

page.notes: The title block is set in large capitals; the first poem and the second poem are separated by a rule. The first word of the second poem carries a large initial. Some words in the first poem are italic; the Latin is partly damaged at the line ends, and words such as "Masuri", "Maonides" and "Captro" are doubtful. Stray ink marks appear in the margins and are not transcribed.
